arabic: إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ.
transliteration: Ithaa du'iya ahadukum falyujib, fa-in kaana saa'iman falyusalli, wa in kaana muftiran falyat'am.
translation: If any of you is invited, let him answer (the invitation). If he is fasting, let him pray (supplicate) for them; and if he is not fasting, let him eat.
